about_the_game:
MeowLand: Island Farm – A Cozy Farming Adventure on a Cat Island! 🌊🐾

Welcome to MeowLand, a charming and relaxing farming simulator set on a beautiful island! Take on the role of a clever kitty farmer as you cultivate the land, grow delicious crops, and work towards fully owning your dream island.

🌱 Plant & Harvest – Sow seeds, water your fields, and use fertilizers to boost your yields. Grow a variety of fruits, vegetables, and grains to sell and trade!
🛳 Trade & Expand – Deliver fresh produce to the bustling port, fulfill special orders, and earn valuable coins to develop your farm.
🏡 Build & Decorate – Upgrade your farm with cozy buildings, charming decorations, and adorable cat-themed accessories to create a true paradise.
📅 Manage Your Time & Resources – Rent is due regularly, so plan your income and expenses wisely to keep your island dream alive!

Explore, farm, and create the perfect cat paradise in MeowLand: Island Farm! 🐱💛

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 (6GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
